name: Razryv vremeni
source:
Was death in the camp predetermined? Fate itself decreed that his path would end in the forest when he dared to step into the forbidden territory.
But was reincarnation predetermined? Was it part of their plan? Or was it just a lucky coincidence?
A man once deprived of luck unexpectedly, even for himself, saw a white stripe on his path.
The one who observes has no right to interfere with the course of events, only to observe.
However, there are loopholes in any rule.
Semyon will have to tear this loop to shreds, cling to the truth, and rush into a multifaceted future.
Great difficulties await him on this path, but also a bright future.
Or maybe not so bright... After all, even fate itself is not kind to him.
Will you, reader and arbiter of fate, help Semyon doom the truth and get out of the eternal camp?
